job.title: Scrub scout nurses Brisbane
job.description:
Scrub/Scout Theatre Nurses – Join Our Brisbane Casual Pool
SureMatch Recruitment is seeking experienced Scrub/Scout Registered Nurses to join our casual theatre nursing pool for temporary shifts across private hospitals in Brisbane.
We welcome nurses with experience across the following specialties:
  • General surgery
  • Orthopaedics
  • Plastics and cosmetic surgery
  • ENT
  • Ophthalmology
  • Urology
  • Gynaecology
  • Obstetrics
  • Colorectal
  • Upper GI and bariatric surgery
  • Vascular
  • Cardiac
  • Neurosurgery
  • Dental and maxillofacial
  • Endoscopy
What we offer:
  • Flexible casual shifts
  • Competitive agency rates
  • Opportunities across Brisbane private hospitals
  • Day, evening and weekend shifts
  • Support from a responsive recruitment team
  • Work that fits around your existing commitments
To be considered, you will require:
  • Current AHPRA registration
  • Recent Scrub/Scout theatre experience
  • Current mandatory competencies 
  • National Police Check
  • Australian working rights
  • Two recent professional references
Whether you are looking for occasional shifts or regular agency work, we would love to hear from you.
Apply now and book your interview today to start accessing upcoming theatre shifts across Brisbane.
